property_summary: For any admissible play, the pot balance after a win must be zero and after a loss must equal the sum of ticket amounts sent; the mutant breaks this by incrementing pot by 11 instead of 10, causing an incorrect pot after a loss.
change_summary: Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += msg.value + 1;` so pot is increased by 11 instead of 10, changing the pot value.
